toegepas.voor: Wie nie as wit ingedeel is nie, is baie van hul regte ontneem, veral swart mense.
toegepas.na: Mense wat nie as wit ingedeel is nie, veral swart mense, is baie van hul regte ontneem.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Singular 'wie' clashes with plural 'hul', and 'veral swart mense' dangles at the end; the qualifier now sits beside the group it narrows, with meaning and 'ingedeel' unchanged.
toegepas.fout: 'veral swart mense' dangles at the end of the sentence, away from the group it narrows, and generic 'wie' sits awkwardly with plural 'hul'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The qualifier now sits beside the group it narrows; same people, same deprivation, 'veral' and the protected 'ingedeel' intact.

toegepas.voor: Dit is om dinge soos kragmaste stukkend te maak om die regering onder druk te sit.
toegepas.na: Sabotasie beteken om dinge soos kragmaste stukkend te maak om die regering onder druk te plaas.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dit is om' could point back to the planning rather than to sabotage, so the term is named as the subject; 'onder druk plaas' is the standard idiom and matches the glossary's 'druk ... plaas'.
toegepas.fout: 'Dit is om' is a vague, stiff link that could point back to the planning rather than to sabotage.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming sabotage as the subject makes the inline explanation unambiguous without changing what it says, and 'onder druk plaas' matches the glossary entry.

toegepas.rede_vinder: For heavy physical labour such as breaking stone, 'swaar werk' is the natural Afrikaans collocation; 'harde werk' leans towards working diligently.
toegepas.fout: 'harde werk' leans towards diligent work; for breaking stone and digging lime the natural collocation is 'swaar werk'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A more exact collocation for heavy physical labour, with the protected 'kalk grawe' and the examples untouched.

laat_vaar.voor: Van sy 27 jaar as politieke gevangene
laat_vaar.na: Van Mandela se 27 jaar as politieke gevangene
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The block opens under a new heading with a bare 'sy', so the referent is named once for a reader who starts here.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'sy' can only refer to Mandela, who is the subject of the block just before it, and the next block opens with a bare 'hy' too, so naming him here alone is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A bare '18' after 'mense van' reads incomplete; 'jaar' makes clear it is an age.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'mense van 18 en ouer' is ordinary, clear Afrikaans for an age in a voting sentence, so adding 'jaar' only reads differently.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Teen mekaar was' is loose and colloquial; 'teen mekaar gestaan het' is the idiomatic way to say people were opposed.
na_skrywer.fout: 'teen mekaar was' in the glossary definition is loose; 'teen mekaar gestaan het' is the idiomatic way to say people were opposed.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The point is fair, but this is a [begrip] definition that may be shared across lessons, so only the writer may reword it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: vir die eerste keer saam stem
vlae.rede: Correctly written as two words (vote together), but a Grade 5 reader may read it as 'saamstem' (agree); not changed because any rewording risks altering the meaning, so the reviewer may want to consider it.
